stage_authorised: PROTOCOL + TOOLING + SYNTHETIC TESTS + DRY-RUN ONLY. No fit, no rollout, no collection, no DAgger, no PPO/critic, no sigma sweep, no production change
kind: ADDITIVE. S1A is definitively NOT_ELIGIBLE and is never used as init, source or anchor. rev3l..rev3r, S0D, S1A and every prior artifact remain immutable

classification.what_this_is: SUPERVISED ANCHORED BRIDGE (self-anchored trust-region refinement): the target labels are the already-frozen AB06 u_IK corpus and the anchor labels are the actor's OWN already-recorded actions on its OWN already-recorded nominal trace
classification.what_this_is_NOT: NOT DAgger. DAgger requires NEW on-policy collection plus teacher relabelling of the newly visited states. Neither happens here: no rollout is executed, no state is newly visited, no label is newly produced by any teacher
classification.july_11_dagger_reference: the 11/07 DAgger was a genuine DAgger (the teacher relabelled the states the actor visited); the 13/07 anchor part was NOT DAgger, it reused the source actor's own recorded actions - the same construction reused here

init_and_source.init: EXACTLY S0D 481dd0d22919fc1ec04cdb722409b9711caeb61d57449c210aad7386375b764a (module_state cda6d893...), the only chain actor with closed-loop evidence (500/500 nominal, 2 cycles, 13.7 mm)
init_and_source.no_hard_replacement: the whole 35D mean network is refit FROM S0D by gradient descent; no weight is copied, replaced, blended or surgically edited

source_equals_init_proof.checkpoint_in_command: student/S0D_35D_DISTILLED/rl_module == the pinned init (verified string-identical in the frozen command)

numpy_forward_vs_recorded_actions.meaning: the recorded raw actions ARE this actor's deterministic mean on those states: source == init, the July 13/07 property (July's homologous figure was float32 rmse 1.19e-07)

limits_vs_13_07.unique_anchor_content: July's 16000 anchors were ONE 500-step episode tiled 32 times (np.tile, --nominal-repeat 32): its UNIQUE content was 500 rows, exactly what we have. The difference is anchor MASS, not information
limits_vs_13_07.mass_reproduced_by_weight_not_tiling: rev3 forbids tiled splits (identical rows on both sides). The July anchor mass (16000 : 8712 = 1.837) is reproduced, where feasible, by an explicit weight ratio
limits_vs_13_07.missing_alt_starts: July also had 8000 teacher rows on the -0.20/+0.20 s starts. We have NO alt-start S0D rollout: producing one is NEW COLLECTION and needs a separate token
limits_vs_13_07.missing_recovery_rows: July had 712 phase-aligned stochastic recovery rows. We have none, and we cannot produce them: sigma is unresolved and no stochastic rollout is authorised
limits_vs_13_07.fundamental_non_equivalence: July's 13/07 target was a teacher ALREADY consistent with the init (aggregate RMSE before = 0.019657, nominal shift RMS after = 0.004175): a refinement under consistency. Our target u_IK CONFLICTS with the init by mean 0.3758 (knee) / 0.3014 (ankle). S1B is therefore NOT the July stage; it is a bounded step under conflict

corpus_frozen_no_new_collection.source: the already-frozen S1/rev3l-rev3q corpus; NO new collection of any kind

anchor_rows.labels: S0D's OWN recorded raw actions on those same states (source==init)

frozen_holdout.role: out-of-sample target measurement; NEVER trained on by EITHER role

corpus_frozen_no_new_collection.leakage_rule: both roles use EXACTLY the frozen 380-row training mask; the holdout stays unseen by both, so the target measurement remains genuinely out-of-sample
corpus_frozen_no_new_collection.deviation_from_july_declared: July's anchors covered the WHOLE nominal episode. Here they are restricted to the frozen training mask to keep the holdout clean. This is a CONSERVATIVE deviation and is declared, not hidden

structural_finding_blocker.identical_inputs_two_labels: anchor rows and task rows are the SAME 380 states. With identical inputs the per-row minimiser of lambda_a*(pi-u_S0D)^2 + lambda_t*(pi-u_IK)^2 is the convex combination pi* = u_S0D + (1/(1+r))*(u_IK - u_S0D), r = lambda_a/lambda_t
structural_finding_blocker.consequence: on the training rows the two-role loss is ANALYTICALLY EQUIVALENT to single-role regression onto a blended label. The anchor role adds nothing the blend would not add THERE; it only acts off the training rows through generalisation
structural_finding_blocker.why_july_differed: July's anchor states were states the teacher rows did NOT cover (different starts), so the two roles genuinely constrained different regions
structural_finding_blocker.honest_consequence: S1B as specifiable TODAY is a TRUST-REGION INTERPOLATION between S0D and u_IK, not the July two-region construction
structural_finding_blocker.only_real_remedy: anchor-only states that the task does not cover, i.e. S0D deterministic rollouts from the -0.20/+0.20 s starts (July's exact structure). That is NEW COLLECTION and requires a separate architect token (proposed name: V26B-S0D-ALTSTART-COLLECTION)

analytic_predictions_from_measured_gap.model: drift = gap/(1+r); target improvement fraction on the training rows = 1/(1+r). The predictions are exact for the per-row minimiser and are recorded so the fit stage FALSIFIES or confirms them
analytic_predictions_from_measured_gap.feasible_band_derivation: P3 (max drift <= 0.25) implies r >= 4.727 on the knee; T1 (improvement >= 10%) implies r <= 9. The feasible band is therefore r in [4.727, 9], narrow but NON-EMPTY, and it is disclosed a priori
analytic_predictions_from_measured_gap.july_reference_point_excluded_by_predict: July's mass ratio 1.837 would give a predicted max drift of 0.505 on the knee, twice the P3 bound. It is infeasible HERE precisely because our target conflicts with the anchors, whereas July's did not. Recorded, not used

candidate_budget_finite_frozen.loss: lambda_a * mean_anchor(row MSE vs u_S0D) + lambda_t * mean_task(row MSE vs u_IK) + 1.0 * action-clip penalty + 1e-5 July parametric anchor towards theta_S0D
candidate_budget_finite_frozen.normalisation: lambda_t := 1 and lambda_a := r; group-balanced per-role means (T1R mechanism), no target-variance normalisation, no aux head
candidate_budget_finite_frozen.determinism: fixed seed, fixed epoch count, deterministic algorithms, clock columns re-zeroed, logstd restored bit-identical. Each candidate is bit-reproducible

candidates.note: same ratio as A3 with a fixed REDUCED step budget (trust region by construction, not early stopping): predictions are upper bounds, the fit is deliberately not converged

candidate_budget_finite_frozen.no_tuning_rule: this grid is the ENTIRE search. No candidate may be added, removed, re-weighted or re-run. If none survives, the protocol fails closed

offline_selection_hierarchy_fail_closed.short_circuit: a candidate failing any level is discarded immediately and the later levels are recorded as not_evaluated

P_preservation_on_anchors.strata: FSM one-hot state, online contact, heel-strike and toe-off flags: every stratum present in the anchor rows is measured separately so no gait phase is silently sacrificed
P_preservation_on_anchors.rationale: a-priori. July achieved a nominal shift RMS of 0.004175 and max 0.031594 under CONSISTENT roles; our bounds are deliberately ~12x looser because we ask a real behaviour change, while max <= 0.25 keeps every single row below the 0.376 structural gap so that no anchor row is converted into the IK target

T_target_improvement.metric: RMSE vs u_IK on the FROZEN holdout steps 201-300 (out-of-sample for both roles)
T_target_improvement.rationale: a-priori round bound, declared as chosen and not derived; it is the smallest improvement that is not holdout noise at 100 rows and it caps the grid at r <= 9
T_target_improvement.explicit_non_claim: improvement is NOT tracking: even the best feasible candidate is predicted to leave the holdout RMSE near 0.52-0.56, far from the 0.15 S1 criterion

D_drift.rationale: S1A, which does NOT walk, had parameter shift 2.4398 and action drift 0.384/0.289. The trust region is set well inside the only measured failure point

offline_selection_hierarchy_fail_closed.no_walking_claim: NO offline metric may declare or suggest walking. Offline selection only decides which candidates are ALLOWED to be tested closed loop

closed_loop_gate_preregistered_separate_.order: candidates evaluated in the FROZEN order A6, A3, A2, A1, A4, A5 restricted to the offline survivors, most-preserving first; STOP at the first PASS or when the budget is exhausted
closed_loop_gate_preregistered_separate_.per_rollout: exactly one launch per candidate, no retry, no tuning, canonical rev3c/e/j command, deterministic mean, seed 123, nominal start 1.956870983805102

binding_gates.penetration: max <= 0.020 m and no grf_penetration termination

mandatory_diagnostics: shape and Pearson correlation vs the prescribed targets
comparison with S0D (500/500, 2 cycles, 13.7 mm), with S1A (392/500, 0 cycles, 24.7 mm) and with the July homologs
B3 only inside the phase window [0.55, 0.80], not_evaluable if the field is zero
closed_loop_gate_preregistered_separate_.promotion_rule: NO candidate and NO anchor corpus is promoted, published as deployable or reused as a source before a closed-loop PASS

sigma_rule: sigma 0.005 stays UNRESOLVED and NON-OPERATIONAL. S1B rollouts use the deterministic mean and never set it. A sweep may only be preregistered later, on an actor that walks

comparison_with_S1A_failure.S1A: same init, same 380 task rows, NO anchor role: measured action drift 0.384/0.289, parameter shift 2.4398, offline G_task 0.134/0.122 PASS, closed loop 392/500 with ZERO valid cycles (one toe-off then 260 swing rows without a heel strike)
comparison_with_S1A_failure.S1B: same init, same rows, PLUS the anchor role: drift bounded by construction to gap/(1+r) <= 0.094 (r >= 3)
comparison_with_S1A_failure.falsifiable_hypothesis: does a bounded step of <= 0.10 preserve the walking cycle that a step of 0.384 destroyed? There is NO evidence either way for intermediate drift: this is exactly what S1B tests
comparison_with_S1A_failure.honest_risk: if walking is lost even at drift 0.04-0.06, the conclusion is that the IK direction is locally incompatible with the gait cycle and the IK line should close

iterative_roadmap_if_S1B_passes: each iteration re-anchors on the NEW walking actor's OWN complete nominal trace (July ordering, iterated). Closing the 0.376 gap at <= 0.10 per step needs about 4 to 6 iterations, each with its own collection, fit and closed-loop token. This is disclosed so the cost is visible before the first step
